## About Vista Alam

## Vista Alam: A Landmark Integrated Development in Shah Alam, Selangor

Vista Alam is a prominent leasehold mixed-development located in the heart of Shah Alam's Section 14, offering a blend of residential comfort and commercial convenience. Developed by Tahap Warisan Sdn Bhd and completed around 2014, this project was one of the first of its kind in the city, integrating serviced apartments, SOHO units, and retail shops.

Prominent medical centres are conveniently located, including Avisena Specialist Hospital (formerly DEMC) situated right in front of the property, and KPJ Selangor Specialist Hospital nearby.

### The Developer

Vista Alam was developed by Tahap Warisan Sdn Bhd, with some sources also crediting Malbase Sdn Bhd.
